title: Rutter SWINTER=3 stateful atmospheric-forcing migration
implemented: B1.11 piecewise-constant Rutter fill/dry event integrator; source-window FMR physical-state candidate; constant surface irrigation routing for both ISUA modes; fimin removed from the Rutter contract
persisted: The rain-only bounded candidate passed INT13 Actions run 37271615834. A local extension now supports constant surface irrigation through both ISUA partitions; this extension awaits a new targeted persisted qualification.
tested: Rain-only Rutter physics/source-window/retry/restart and production FMR passed persisted run 37271615834. Local current candidate passes B1.11 ISUA=0/nonzero hand-oracle and immutable irrigation-window tests, FMR production with both ISUA modes at the tested low-rate forcing, PPA-WU01 O0/O2, and source-window O0/O2.
latest_audit_findings: Exact B1.11 MOD_meteo.f90 member reconstructed from the release archive; SHA-256 99fbf7ad4d90f71cc86012e8e1c9970ef4ca40ea879f0f0622a02a0c33be4c9f.
B1.11 Rutter uses piecewise constant canopy input/output fluxes with internal fill and dry event times. It does not use fimin or the SWAP 4.2.0 exponential storage equation.
The current source-window integrator resolves B1.11-style process events internally and returns interval-average fluxes; event transitions do not command Richards substeps.

Constant surface irrigation now passes the B1.11 ISUA=0 intercepted and ISUA/=0 rain-only partitions in local process and FMR production tests. The production test uses a low irrigation rate of 0.01 cm/day with 0.2 cm rainfall per source window.

Higher tested irrigation throughfall combinations reached the Reference Richards error "HeadCalc: dynamic head regime omitted surface-head derivative". Those high-forcing combinations remain outside this qualification pending the separately owned top-boundary/Jacobian issue.
The previous persisted INT13 run 37271615834 qualifies the rain-only candidate, not this surface-irrigation extension.
next_action: Run the targeted INT13 physics and FMR production qualification on the constant-surface-irrigation extension, then persist the exact tested envelope while retaining the high-throughfall solver limitation.
blockers: The constant surface-irrigation extension has local O0/O2 verification but no persisted qualification on its current candidate commit.
Higher tested surface-irrigation throughfall reaches the dynamic head regime surface-head derivative error and is excluded from the tested envelope.
dependency_surface: SWINTER=0/1/2, Black and Boesten preservation interfaces
